chapter: Opening, St. Catharines Hall and the Odd Fellows
title: Catholic upbringing, the Odd Fellows regiment and Peter Ogden Day parades
summary: Dawson explains he left the Catholic church when he joined fraternal orders, describes his rank in the Grand United Order of Odd Fellows military department and its parades, and says he has marched since 1920.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs
